assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: full-bleed 16:9 landscape world map background for a polished Korean elementary science RPG. Create an exceptionally charming, richly detailed 2.5D pixel-art sound-science village in a lush forest, viewed diagonally from above around 35 degrees, crisp carefully clustered pixels, beautifully shaded rounded forms, premium handheld RPG environmental art. Target 1600x900, wide composition, no border. Five DISTINCT small facilities plus one central sound-core monument connected by wide sandy walking paths, absolutely no text or labels, no UI or people. Layout measured as percentage of image: turquoise-roof vibration research cottage with a tuning fork emblem at (21%,29%), honey-orange-roof small round drum arena at (49%,23%), lavender-roof music workshop with kalimba roof ornament at (80%,31%), mint-roof communications observatory at (77%,69%), coral-roof peaceful reading cottage at (24%,72%), a small blue crystal sound-core on a round stone plaza at (51%,58%). Buildings front doors face down towards visible paths: doors near (21%,42%), (49%,36%), (80%,44%), (77%,83%), (24%,86%); central plaza accessible at (51%,70%). Every door joins a continuous generous pale sandy path, a loop path goes through the middle and round the core. Keep paths clear, broad and visually unmistakable. Dense emerald and sage trees frame the perimeter; turquoise river along left edge and a little upper-right pond with a wooden bridge; tiny cream daisies, soft grasses, low wooden fences, warm brass lamps, stone edging, tree trunks and layered foliage. Environment feels spacious yet full of appealing details, one coherent landscape, warm morning light with subtle long shadows. Buildings unlit but colorful, no fog baked in; activation glow will be added in game. Clear ground for moving sprites. Avoid labels, letters, numbers, menus, text, people, characters, noisy photorealism, empty flat polygon terrain, large blank margins, floating islands, photorealistic 3D.

assets.name: explorer-walk
assets.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: a production-ready transparent pixel RPG animation sprite sheet. Use the attached character design only as identity reference; re-render as polished crisp 2.5D pixel art in a 16-bit RPG style. EXACT 4 columns by 4 rows, 16 equal-sized square cells, no lines or visible grid. Every cell contains the same full-body character at exactly the same scale and centered x position; all feet on identical local baseline at 85% of cell height. Generous fully transparent margin within each cell, no overlapping between cells. Row 1 facing down toward camera, Row 2 facing left, Row 3 facing right, Row 4 facing away/up. Columns are four distinct seamless walking-cycle poses: left foot forward, passing, right foot forward, passing. Camera slightly above, orthographic, coherent lighting. Genuine transparent alpha background. NO labels, numbers, text, panel backgrounds, shadows, checkerboard, arrows, weapons, held tools, or extra characters. Character occupies 65% of cell height; all parts fully in cell. Subject is ONLY the girl explorer from the middle of the reference: friendly brown ponytail with teal hair tie, cream and turquoise science jacket, navy shorts, teal backpack with orange straps, white socks, blue boots. Preserve brown hair and the same clothes in every frame. Exclude the boy and bird. Match head/body proportions of an adorable small RPG hero, readable eyes, 3-heads-tall proportions.
